findings.title: Return generic client errors instead of raw internal errors.
findings.rationale:
Both branches expose err.Error() to the caller. Database errors can disclose SQL, schema, host, or driver details. Return a stable public message and log the original error through the server-side logger.

Proposed fix

-		http.Error(w, err.Error(), http.StatusBadGateway) +		http.Error(w, "failed to load monthly totals", http.StatusBadGateway) ... -		http.Error(w, err.Error(), http.StatusInternalServerError) +		http.Error(w, "failed to encode monthly totals", http.StatusInternalServerError)
